_comment: Domains/addresses are matched against the From header (substring, case-insensitive). Subject keywords are matched against the Subject header (substring, case-insensitive). A message is treated as a receipt if it matches a sender pattern, OR if it matches a subject keyword AND comes from a domain that looks transactional (heuristic). You can freely add/remove entries.
_live_receipt_comment: If an email body contains a link matching one of these patterns, receipt_archiver can optionally load that page in a real (headless) browser and render THAT page to PDF instead of the email's own HTML -- useful for POS emails that are mostly a thin wrapper around a 'view your full receipt' link. Requires the 'playwright' package and 'playwright install chromium'. See --live-render / --no-live-render.
